v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

text.la: Beáta es, * Virgo María, quæ ómnium portásti Creatórem.
text.en: Blessed art thou, * O Virgin Mary, who didst bear the Creator of all things.

text.la: Genuísti, * qui te fecit, et in ætérnum pérmanes Virgo.
text.en: Thou didst bring him forth * who made thee, and remainest a Virgin for ever.

text.la: Cum essem párvula, * plácui Altíssimo et de meis viscéribus génui Deum et hóminem.
text.en: When I was a little one, * I pleased the Most High, and from my womb I have brought forth God and man.

text.la: Benedícta fília * tu a Dómino, quia per te fructum vitæ communicávimus.
text.en: Daughter, thou art blessed * of the Lord: for by thee we have partaken of the fruit of life.

text.la: Vidérunt eam * fíliæ Sion, et beátam dixérunt, et regínæ laudavérunt eam.
text.en: The daughters of Sion, * saw her, and called her blessed; and the queens praised her.

text.la: Qui creávit me, requiévit in tabernáculo meo, et dixit mihi: in Iacob inhábita, et in eléctis meis mitte radíces.
text.en: He that made me, rested in my tabernacle, and he said to me: Let thy dwelling be in Jacob, and thy inheritance in Israel, and take root in my elect.

text.la: Prima stropha sequentis hymni dicitur flexis genibus.
text.en: The first verse of the following hymn is said genuflecting.

r.en: And blessed is the fruit of thy womb.

text.la: Matérnitas tua, * Dei Génetrix Virgo, gáudium annuntiávit univérso mundo: ex te enim ortus est sol iustítiæ, Christus Deus noster.
text.en: Thy maternity, * O Virgin Mother of God, announced joy to the whole world; for out of thee arose the sun of justice, Christ our God.

text.la: Deus, qui de beátæ Maríæ Vírginis útero Verbum tuum, Angelo nuntiánte, carnem suscípere voluísti: præsta supplícibus tuis: ut qui vere eam Genetrícem Dei crédimus, eius apud te intercessiónibus adiuvémur.
text.en: O God, who didst will that, at the announcement of an Angel, thy Word should take flesh in the womb of the Blessed Virgin Mary, grant to us thy suppliants, that we who believe her to be truly the Mother of God may be helped by her intercession with thee.
